_what: The docs' provenance record. Every doc in docs/ was verified against exactly this code state; tools/docs_check.py holds the repo to it. Doc syncs are tagged sync-<arc>[.n]; real semver begins at public launch.

upstream._what: The newest genesis-village main these docs SHOULD describe. Bumped as part of the world's converge ritual. When it moves past verified_against, every non-concept doc must flip status: stale until a sync pass re-verifies and re-pins — a doc that reads current but describes shipped-past behaviour is the failure this file exists to prevent.
